description: This file defines a custom Spring condition class 'SelfServiceModuleIsEnabledCondition' which extends PropertiesCondition to determine whether the Self Service module is enabled based on Fineract properties.

classes.name: SelfServiceModuleIsEnabledCondition
classes.description: A Spring condition class that checks if the Self Service module is enabled in the application's configuration.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to return true if the Self Service module is enabled in the provided FineractProperties.
